articles.title: Bybit joins Western Union’s new USDPT network as stablecoin expands distribution
articles.snippet: The exchange integration gives Western Union’s dollar-pegged token access to crypto market liquidity as payment providers accelerate their adoption of stablecoins.

articles.title: Hermes Ends AI Agent Terminal Era With Release of Official Desktop App
articles.snippet: Until now, the only way to run Hermes was through a terminal—or one of several unofficial GUIs the community had cobbled together.

articles.title: George Santos Referred to DOJ, CFTC Over State of the Union Kalshi Trades: Report
articles.snippet: The pardoned ex-congressman allegedly bet against his own State of the Union appearance while publicly hyping it.
